question: Do species pairs that share LGM climatic refugial opportunity show spatially concordant post-IBD mitochondrial genetic discontinuities?
historical_disclosure: The global 211-species Phase-4 result is already known, so this is a targeted secondary analysis. This contract forbids using species-level Phase-4 outputs to choose the subpanel, SDM relation, break-surface definition, split, covariates or qualification thresholds.

per_species_break_surface.genetic_edge_response: Use the already frozen Phase-4 locality-pair COI p-distance and endpoint-safe leave-two-localities-out rank-IBD residualization without refitting any genetic method parameter.
per_species_break_surface.break_weight: positive part of the frozen post-IBD residual turnover rank; w_e=max(r_e,0)
per_species_break_surface.zero_positive_mass: If any authorized species has zero total positive break weight, stop as NOT_EVALUABLE_BREAK_SURFACE; do not drop that species.
per_species_break_surface.bandwidth_provenance: Inherited unchanged from genetic TTF v0.11 / phylogatR Phase-3 core; no re-optimization on this subpanel.
per_species_break_surface.common_grid: 100-km equal-area Palearctic grid clipped to the authoritative WWF Palearctic realm.
per_species_break_surface.normalization: Normalize each species break-intensity surface to sum 1 over the common grid.

pairwise_response.role_geometry: Only cross-role pairs from the deterministic balanced source/target split in the eligibility contract are used.
pairwise_response.raw_response: Y_break(s,t)=Schoener D between source and target normalized break-intensity surfaces.
pairwise_response.analysis_response: rank-normalize Y_break across authorized cross-role dyads, then z-standardize once before the dyadic model.
pairwise_response.directionality: The biological response is symmetric, but source/target roles are kept disjoint solely to preserve the existing two-way endpoint dependence structure.

primary_model.endpoint_adjustment: exact source and target fixed effects
primary_model.inference: two-way source/target cluster-robust one-sided test for positive beta_LGM
primary_model.interpretation_positive: Greater shared LGM climatic refugial opportunity is associated with greater spatial concordance of post-IBD genetic discontinuity within the prespecified Palearctic terrestrial-insect panel.
primary_model.interpretation_negative: No detectable association under this qualified design; not proof that shared refugia never structure comparative phylogeographic breaks.

required_before_response_opening: LGM and current SDM relations frozen
null qualification passes at A=0,1,2,3 for the intended dyadic estimator
evaluable grid MDE is <=0.10 at A=0,1,2
authorization_rule.A3_role: stress regime reported but A3 MDE need not be <=0.10; null qualification must still pass

forbidden: choosing a different break threshold after seeing genetic outcomes
changing the inherited 500-km genetic kernel bandwidth
dropping species because their genetic break surface looks unusual
redefining the Palearctic or terrestrial filter after genetic outcome inspection
replacing R_LGM with an alternative palaeoclimate relation because the primary association is weak
using the already-known global Phase-4 species-level scores to tune any part of this targeted analysis
